Vamshi Nath Vunnam

Software Engineer II | Full-Stack .NET / Angular / SQL | AI Automation Specialist vamshinathc@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/vamshinath-vunnam | Hyderabad, India (Open to Remote)

TECHNICAL SKILLS

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Languages & Frameworks C# . ASP.NET Core . .NET Standard . VB.NET . TypeScript . Angular . SQL . Python . HTML/CSS Databases & Search SQL Server . Elasticsearch . PostgreSQL . Oracle Cloud & DevOps AWS (ECS, S3, Lambda, EC2) . Docker . Kubernetes . Azure DevOps . GitHub Actions . JFrog AI & Automation Claude Code . Cline . GitHub Copilot . RAG . LLM Integration . AI Agent Development MCP Servers Azure DevOps . GitHub . Datadog . Playwright . SQL Server . Saffron Design Observability & Tools Datadog . Postman . Jira . Power BI . DBeaver . Swagger

Full-stack Software Engineer with 8.5 years of experience building enterprise .NET/Angular/SQL systems, specialising in AI-powered developer automation. At Thomson Reuters, led GTM's first large-scale product modernisation and built a complete AI workflow platform — 6 custom Claude Code agents integrating 6 MCP servers — automating release orchestration across 13 repositories, QA test generation, production root-cause analysis, and enterprise PR reviews. Open to senior engineering, tech lead, and AI tooling roles at remote- first companies.

EXPERIENCE

Thomson Reuters Software Engineer II (Promoted Mar 2026) | Nov 2021 – Present OneSource Global Trade Management . Denied Party Screening (DPS) . Hyderabad, India

Leadership & Product Ownership

Led GTM's first large-scale product extraction: migrated DPS from monolithic .NET Framework 4.7.2 (VB) to ASP.NET Core/.NET Standard (C#) on AWS ECS containers — delivered with zero Customer Impacting Events at launch, now serving 350+ global enterprise clients processing millions of screenings daily

Promoted to Software Engineer II (Mar 2026); acting Dev Lead for 6+ months owning sprint planning, architectural decisions, and cross-functional coordination across engineering, QA, DevOps, and stakeholders

CERTIFICATIONS

AWS Certified Developer – Associate | 2020

Architected independently deployable, containerised DPS platform eliminating GTM release coupling and enabling serverless cost optimisation through elastic scaling to zero during low-activity periods

AI Automation & Developer Productivity

AI/ML Upskilling Program | Thomson Reuters | 2024

KEY HIGHLIGHTS

Promoted to SE II — Mar 2026 • Far Exceeded Rating — 2025 • 2x AI Hackathon Winner (2024) • Zero CIEs — DPS 25.3 Release • Spotlight Award Recipient • Led GTM's 1st Product Extraction • Serving 350+ Enterprise Clients

Built 6 production-grade Claude Code agents: NuGet version orchestration across 13 repos with automated ADO pipeline chaining (37->229->216->59); QA test case generation from ADO work items via Playwright MCP + SQL MCP; production root-cause analysis via Datadog MCP log correlation; enterprise PR reviews integrating GitHub MCP, SQL Server MCP, and Saffron MCP

Integrated 6 MCP servers (Azure DevOps, GitHub, Datadog, Playwright, SQL Server, Saffron) into team-wide workflows, automating repetitive engineering tasks and significantly reducing manual overhead

Built RAG-based chatbots and an AI Anomaly Detection tool for DPS monitoring; collaborating with GTMGarage on an AI solution to eliminate vendor RNI plugin dependency

EDUCATION

Won Best Pitch at CT&T AI Hackathon and Global AI Hackathon challenge winner (2024); participated in 2025 Global AI Hackathon building Angular-to-React AI migration agent

B.Tech — Electronics & Communication Engineering

Delivered AI training workshops on Claude Code, MCP integrations, and AI-assisted development; drove team-wide adoption of AI tooling across the engineering organisation

Engineering Excellence

VIT University, Vellore 2017 | CGPA: 8.45 / 10

Achieved zero CIEs in the 25.3 release; resolved all P1/P2 issues within SLA throughout tenure; fixed long-standing AT&T batch processing failures affecting millions of nightly screening transactions

Streamlined RNI plugin deployment from manual process to S3-based API workflow, reducing effort across all environments and handing off operations to the Release Management team

Delivered DPS features: batch monitoring, spreadsheet uploads, graylist management, AWS Translate integration, and cross-language tuning for enterprise clients including Costco and AT&T

Received multiple Thomson Reuters recognition awards (Ignite, Shine, Transcend) for production issue resolution, after-hours support, and cross-team contributions

Cognizant Technology Solutions Associate – Software Engineer | Oct 2017 – Nov 2021 Client: Cargill Risk Management & Trade Applications . .NET Core / Angular / PostgreSQL . Chennai, India

Led Level I/II error analysis and resolution for 9 cloud-hosted microservices (.NET Core, Angular, PostgreSQL) using Datadog and Kubernetes; served as technical lead for offshore team

Delivered enhancements and production deployments for Customer Facing and Technical Services .NET applications serving Cargill's global agribusiness operations

Automated data reporting workflows using Power BI, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server; presented performance dashboards to leadership — earned "Exceeds All Expectations" rating from Cargill account

Earned AWS Certified Developer – Associate certification (July 2020) during tenure
